entries.title: Psalms 27:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> The LORD [is] my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD [is] the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

words.text: ; of whom shall I be afraid

entries.title: Psalms 27:2
segments: When the wicked, [even] mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell. {came...: Heb. approached against me}

entries.title: Psalms 27:3
segments: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this [will] I [be] confident.

words.text: against me, in this [will] I [be] confident

entries.title: Psalms 27:4
segments: One [thing] have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple. {the beauty: or, the delight}

entries.title: Psalms 27:5
segments: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

words.text: me; he shall set me up

entries.title: Psalms 27:6
segments: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD. {joy: Heb. shouting}

entries.title: Psalms 27:7
segments: ¶Hear, O LORD, [when] I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

entries.title: Psalms 27:8
segments: [When thou saidst], Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek. {When...: or, My heart said unto thee, Let my face seek thy face, etc}

words.text: . {When...: or, My heart said unto thee, Let my face seek thy face, etc}

entries.title: Psalms 27:9
segments: Hide not thy face [far] from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 27:10
segments: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up. {take...: Heb. gather me}

entries.title: Psalms 27:11
segments: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies. {a plain...: Heb. a way of plainness} {mine...: Heb. those which observe me}

words.text: . {a plain...: Heb. a way of plainness} {mine...: Heb. those which observe me}

entries.title: Psalms 27:12
segments: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

words.text: me not over unto the will
against me, and such as breathe out

entries.title: Psalms 27:13
segments: [I had fainted], unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

entries.title: Psalms 27:14
segments: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
